caseName: Boston Firefighters Union, Local 718 v. Boston Chapter, NAACP
caseNameFull: Boston Firefighters Union, Local 718 v. Boston Chapter, NAACP Boston Police Patrolmen's Assn., Inc. v. Castro and Beecher v. Boston Chapter, NAACP

opinions.text:
C. A. 1st Cir. [Certiorari granted, ante, *1100p. 967.] Motions of Washington Legal Foundation, American Federation of Labor and Congress of Industrial Organizations et al., and Pacific Legal Foundation for leave to file briefs as amici curiae granted.

Justice Marshall took no part in the consideration or decision of these motions.
